summary: Defensive farming civ. Cheap farms, Longbowmen and the Network of Castles bonus make it hard to attack near its Town Centers.

spikes.label: Vanguard Men-at-Arms
spikes.detail: English get Vanguard Men-at-Arms in the Dark Age for very early pressure.
spikes.answer: Wall or palisade your wood line and keep villagers near the Town Center.

spikes.label: Longbow push
spikes.detail: Longbowmen out-range other archers. With Council Hall they train them twice as fast.
spikes.answer: Horsemen and Men-at-Arms beat longbows; avoid fighting near their Town Center.

spikes.label: Fortified base
spikes.detail: Units near their Town Centers, towers and keeps attack 20% faster. A defensive English player is hard to crack in Castle.
spikes.answer: Bring siege like Mangonels and Springalds rather than fighting under their buildings.

scout: Abbey of Kings means sustain and a defensive plan
King's Palace means a strong Town Center for booming

pairings.why: Long range plus a tough front line.
Cheap and good against cavalry raids.

winConditions.detail: Out-farm the opponent and win the late game.
Hold the map with towers and keeps, then push with siege.
